create_logger: create a logger with file and console handlers using create_logger with filepath and rank
create_log_formatter: create a LogFormatter instance that formats log records with elapsed time and level name
reset_logger_time: reset the logger elapsed time by calling the reset_time method on the logger object
review_LogFormatter_format: review the LogFormatter format method to understand how it prefixes log messages with level and elapsed time
build_logger_multi_process: build a multi-process logging setup by passing different rank values to create_logger for separate log files
